data.name: Bhagirath
data.gender_notes: Bhagirath is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Bhagirath was a sage who brought salvation to his ancestors by pleading with Lord Brahma to release the Ganges from the heavens so that their souls could be purified and reach moksha. The name Bhagirath carries the meaning “Bringer of salvation” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bhagirath usually hope their child will grow to embody bringer of salvation and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Bhagirath represents the power of devotion and determination to seek salvation for one's ancestors.
data.etymology: Bhagirath belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Bringer of salvation.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bhagirath total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

data.cultural_impact: Rama is an iconic figure of Hinduism and Indian culture. He is revered as an embodiment of duty, righteousness and selflessness. The Ramayana has had a profound influence on Indian literature, art and folklore.
data.spiritual_significance: Rama's story is a reminder of the importance of dharma or duty, and how one must uphold it at all costs, even if it goes against their personal desires and happiness. It also underscores the idea of self-sacrifice and the utter devotion towards one's duties and obligations towards society and family.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Bhagirath symbolizes the power of unwavering devotion and selfless sacrifice. He is the one who brought the sacred Ganga river to Earth, redeeming his ancestors and attaining salvation for them. Thus, Bhagirath represents the transformative power of spiritual longing and collective redemption.

vedic_reference.note: Bhagiratha is a sage and king mentioned in Hindu mythology, who performed a great penance to bring the Ganges river to India, so that his ancestors could attain salvation.

modern_usage.modern_context: In today's interconnected world, the name Bhagirath continues to be cherished by Hindu families globally. It is frequently featured on social media platforms where parents share their naming journeys, and Hindu name websites where expectant parents research meaningful names. The name bridges traditional Hindu values with modern Indian identity, making it relevant for contemporary families seeking names with deep spiritual and cultural significance.

name_in_real_life.story: Priya Bhagirath, a teacher in Kolkata, India, shares that their name Bhagirath meaning "Bringer of salvation" has been a constant source of inspiration, motivating them to follow Hindu values and serve their community.
